description: A .NET CQRS/ES framework built on NStore and MongoDB providing strongly typed aggregate identities, projection engines, atomic read models, and Rebus-based messaging.
rules: Call MongoFlatMapper.EnableFlatMapping() before calling MessagesRegistration.RegisterAssembly(...); reversing the order causes IIdentity values to be stored as nested Mongo documents instead of flat strings.
Define aggregate ids by inheriting from EventStoreIdentity, then register them with IdentityManager before generating or parsing any ids.
Generate new aggregate ids through IdentityManager.New<T>() or NewAsync<T>(); never construct EventStoreIdentity instances directly.
Read atomic read models through IAtomicCollectionReader<TModel>; do not query the underlying Mongo collection directly as the reader handles catch-up and version gating.
The primary LLM documentation lives under llm/; follow the progressive-disclosure structure — start with an overview README, then follow links only when deeper detail is needed.
Projection dispatch uses slots as the unit of ordered processing; inspect ProjectionEngine and IConcurrentCheckpointTracker before debugging individual projection handlers.
Use Castle.Windsor as the IoC container; the framework registers its own components and expects Windsor to resolve IProjection and IAtomicReadModel implementations.
